contract.classification: exploratory synthetic dimensionless software benchmark; no physical validity claimed
contract.protocol_status: v2 exploratory protocol; conditions fixed in the script before this final run; not formal preregistration
contract.equation_preservation: digital_to_wave.encode_wave is unchanged; signed-amplitude equation and sign-phase convention are identical to the existing implementation
contract.paper_equation: S_ijk(t) = (|N_ijk| A_min) sin(omega t + phi(N_ijk)); phi=pi/4 for N>0 and 5pi/4 for N<0; zero maps to zero amplitude
contract.paper_source_location: DigitaltoWave-1, printed page 12 (as recorded in the project README)

testbench_choices.decoder: least-squares projection onto the nominal sin(omega*n + pi/4) reference
testbench_choices.frame_pass_rule: inclusive: a 32-value frame passes iff max absolute input/reconstruction residual <= tolerance
testbench_choices.random_streams: NumPy SeedSequence(master_seed).spawn; one child generator per noise pattern/model/level/trial
testbench_choices.laplace_scale: b = requested sample standard deviation / sqrt(2), giving the same marginal variance as Gaussian at equal listed std
testbench_choices.phase_mismatch_definition: deterministic projection/rotation in the nominal single-carrier sine/cosine subspace; one frame per pattern and offset; arbitrary idealized software stress test, not a physical channel, timing model, or measured receiver mismatch
testbench_choices.zero_output_comparison: weak sanity floor only: returns 32 zeros without using the received waveform; not a competing decoder and not evidence of superiority over a fair alternative
testbench_choices.alternative_nonzero_baseline: none; no non-zero baseline is included because this protocol does not define an independently justified receiver with comparable information/assumptions
testbench_choices.confidence_intervals: two-sided 95% Wilson score intervals for pass rates in stochastic nonzero sample-noise cells; omitted for zero-noise/deterministic rows and the deterministic zero-output baseline; pooled aggregate intervals use a binomial approximation over the balanced fixed vector panel
testbench_choices.uncertainty_scope: Intervals quantify finite Monte Carlo uncertainty conditional on this synthetic protocol, not physical validity or model selection; pooled Wilson intervals are approximate when pass probabilities differ by fixed input pattern, so per-pattern intervals are more direct

metric_definitions.mae_rmse_median_p95_max: component absolute-error summaries pooled over trials and vector entries; p95 uses NumPy linear quantile convention
metric_definitions.frames_passing: number of frames satisfying the inclusive maximum-absolute residual threshold
metric_definitions.frame_pass_share: frames_passing divided by trials; aggregate rows pool the six equally sized vector patterns
metric_definitions.wilson95_lower_upper: 95% Wilson score interval for stochastic matched-filter frame pass shares; null where not applicable
